stem.text: A length of wire RS has a circular cross-section.

stem.alt: Tapered wire drawn as a cylinder narrowing from end R to end S, with the labels area A at R and area A/2 at S.

stem.text: At end R of the wire, the cross-sectional area is $A$.
At end S of the wire, the cross-sectional area is $\dfrac{A}{2}$.
Charge $Q$ takes time $t$ to pass through end R of the wire. There is a constant electric current in the wire.
How much charge will pass through end S in a time interval of $\dfrac{t}{4}$?
